bibl.title: San Colluto su una copertina in pelle da Antinoupolis.
bibl.seg: Anna Di Giglio & Rosario Pintaudi, San Colluto su una copertina in pelle da Antinoupolis.
bibl.note: A large cover fragment of a book codex of Antinoite origin, was recovered from the Egyptian antiquarian market in Cairo in the 1970s. In the foreground there is Christ and next to him San Colluto.
